evidence: GlobalizationWasmApp/wwwroot/index.html reads culture and calls Blazor.start({ applicationCulture: culture }) with autostart=false.
Boot.WebAssembly.ts passes options to startWebAssembly; Boot.WebAssembly.Common.ts loads MonoPlatform and calls platform.callEntryPoint once for that start.

MonoPlatform passes applicationCulture to dotnet.withApplicationCulture. Its loaded-config callback sets __BLAZOR_SHARDED_ICU=1 exactly when globalizationMode is Sharded and exposes loadedConfig.applicationCulture.
WebAssemblyHostBuilder.CreateDefault initializes WebAssemblyCultureProvider, which captures the application culture.
GlobalizationWasmApp.Program.ConfigureCulture reads dotNetCulture and assigns DefaultThreadCurrentCulture and DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture before host.RunAsync.
actualSourceProducer.boundary: Actual source producer and condition mapped. No executed boot config or runtime globalization mode was inspected, so the sharded branch is not claimed to have run.

evidence: WebAssemblyHost.RunAsyncCore invokes ThrowIfCultureChangeIsUnsupported before current-culture resource loading and root rendering.
WebAssemblyCultureProvider throws the exact expected InvalidOperationException prefix when __BLAZOR_SHARDED_ICU is 1 and CurrentCulture.Name differs from InitialCulture.Name.
MonoPlatform.callEntryPoint awaits runtime.runMain, catches its error, calls console.error(error), then showErrorNotification.
MonoPlatform's configured printErr is another console.error plus showErrorNotification route; no browser-entry count is inferred from either call site.
The existing target waits for that UI state, then retrieves Severe browser logs and asserts the expected text.
actualSourceProducer.boundary: No managed exception, console event, LogEntry, callback, browser DOM or log batch was synthesized or executed.

concreteCollectionAndLifetime.seleniumReturnType: LSP resolves ILogs.GetLog(string) as ReadOnlyCollection<LogEntry>; this is navigation metadata, not an executed browser result.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.owningExtension: src\Shared\E2ETesting\WebDriverExtensions.cs:12-28, whole-file identical in Original and Default.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.retrieval: Exactly one driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser) invocation per GetBrowserLogs call.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.materialization: The extension filters Level >= requested level and ShouldIgnore, then calls ToList. It returns that nonempty List<LogEntry> via IReadOnlyList<LogEntry>, or Array.Empty<LogEntry> for null/empty results.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.targetProjection: The target's .Select(l => l.Message) is a deferred projection over the already materialized snapshot. Any can stop early; the eager Join enumerates that same snapshot afterward. Neither enumeration calls Selenium GetLog again or incorporates subsequently arriving browser entries.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.lifetime: The list/projection are method locals for this synchronous assertion. BrowserFixture may reuse a browser via its isolation-context dictionary, but this log list is freshly materialized by each extension call and is not placed into that fixture cache.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.surroundingLogs: ServerTestBase issues console.clear at initialization; CaptureSeleniumLogsAttribute reads log kinds after a test. Neither proves a fixed target snapshot size, nor is console.clear assumed to reset the WebDriver buffer.
concreteCollectionAndLifetime.unknown: No observed number/length/order of actual entries, browser buffering or truncation effects, background/network entries, remote-log reset behavior, or full log-drain lifecycle.

assertionAndMessage.eagerness: Both C# arguments are evaluated before the direct Assert.True call. The string.Join(Environment.NewLine, logs) and interpolation run when argument evaluation reaches them even if Any is true and the assertion passes.
assertionAndMessage.diagnosticText: Expected to see globalization error message in the browser logs: {all snapshot messages joined with Environment.NewLine}.
assertionAndMessage.preservation: No candidate was authored, so message text, punctuation, separator, entry order, retrieval timing and exception behavior are unchanged. No diagnostic-equivalence test was run.

cardinalityAndMateriality.sourceBound: The target contains no repeated Join loop or lazy re-query to the browser. Snapshot size and total characters are not bounded by the extension; they depend on real browser/runtime/network output.
cardinalityAndMateriality.decision: No materially justified private performance candidate. Stop at source-only handoff rather than amplify one diagnostic with fabricated logs, a culture matrix, repetition, isolated Join benchmarks, timing, allocation counters or profiling.
cardinalityAndMateriality.lowerBoundaryFalsePassRisk: Supplying hand-built LogEntry collections or manually invoking console/error callbacks could prove downstream formatting only, while bypassing boot sharding, real managed startup failure, browser console production and Selenium collection.
